title: HydroPulse v2.1.8 - Update Engine Fixes, Duplicate Dialog Prevention & Reliable Release Delivery
changelog: Guaranteed Version Delivery: Update packages are served directly via version-specific binaries to prevent CDN edge and browser caching.
Duplicate Download Prompt Prevention: Completely eliminated stacked and duplicate Update Available dialogs while an update is actively downloading.
Service-Level Download Protection: Background resume, periodic checks, dashboard navigation, and MQTT announcements respect active download state.
Sub-300ms Motor Control: Visually instant pump start/stop with optimistic locking and anti-flap window.
Hardware State Memory: Motor state and automation mode persisted in SharedPreferences and restored on reconnect.
Offline Flash Fix: Preserves live MQTT heartbeat on refresh with 2000ms verification window.
Backend 300ms Watchdog: Cloud evaluates hardware online status every 300ms proactively.
